html:
Manuel Noriega was a Panamanian general who was the real ruler of Panama from 1983 to 1989. He was removed by an American invasion and jailed in the United States for drug trafficking.

The intelligence chief of Torrijos, he was paid by the CIA for years while also helping drug cartels, including the Medellín Cartel, move cocaine and money. He took control of the army in 1983 and made and unmade presidents.

In 1988 American courts charged him with drug trafficking. In 1989 he annulled an election his candidate had lost, and his thugs beat opposition leaders in the street. In December the United States invaded, and he surrendered in January 1990. He spent most of his remaining life in prison in the United States, France and Panama.
sum: Manuel Noriega was a Panamanian general who was the real ruler of Panama from 1983 to 1989. He was removed by an American invasion and jailed in the United States for drug trafficking.
